INNER HEAD. [3] [Carb. ac.]
Dull frontal headache, as if an india-rubber band was stretched tightly over forehead, from temple to temple.
Dull, heavy pain through temples, with tight band across forehead, and tightness in nose between eyes.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Carb. ac.]
Very severe orbital neuralgia over right eye.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Carb. ac.]
Intensely bad smell from mouth. θ Diphtheria. θ Scarlatina. θ Constipation.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Carb. ac.]
Fauces fiery red, swollen ; diphtheritic patches ; breath almost unbearable. θ Scarlatina.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Carb. ac.]
Cancer of stomach.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Carb. ac.]
Vesicular eruption on hands and all over body, which itches excessively ; > after rubbing, but leaving a burning pain.
   

NERVES. [36] [Carb. ac.]
Profound prostration ; physical exhaustion ; surface pale, bathed in cold sweat ; collapse.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Carb. ac.]
Putrid discharges from mouth, throat, nostrils, ears, rectum and vagina.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Carb. ac.]
Lacerated wounds from blunt instruments ; bones bare or crushed and splintered.
   

SKIN. [46] [Carb. ac.]
Malignant forms of scarlatina.
